first_party_pages.observation: Rare-book viewing/copying require an advance application; when available, microfilm/book surrogates are normally used; email/post/fax applications permitted; no telephone submission; postal copying service not offered to individuals.
Thread-bound Chinese books and fragile materials are excluded from the self-service photocopier; self-photography not permitted in the posted general guidance.
Publication/reprint/broadcast request scope is distinct from viewing or research copying. Photography/copying vendor fees may apply; image reuse is not automatically licensed by research access.
Institute library current portal gives institutional contact and notes Asian Research Library East Asian Studies branch identity; institutional service has to be rechecked before any application.
